tip.zh:
🏠 今日北京 08:20 实况为晴，气温 9.0°C、体感 5.0°C，湿度 28%，西北风 33.8 km/h（风力 5 级），阵风 33.8 km/h，紫外线很弱（UV 2），能见度 30.0 km，无降水。市气象台 11 月 26 日 14:40 发布大风蓝色预警：预计 27 日 02 时至 20 时，大部分地区有 3、4 级偏北风，阵风 7 级左右，山区局地阵风可达 9 级以上。今天预报白天晴、夜间多云，0~10°C（体感约 -4.0~7.3°C），日降水概率 0%，日照 9.2 小时；日出 07:12，日落 16:51。日最大阵风 50.0 km/h（阵风 7 级）。逐时方面，09:00 这一时次给出「小雨」、降水概率 55%，但降水量为 0.0 mm；10:00 起转为多云或晴，降水概率均为 0%。日预报为晴、降水概率 0%，08:20 实况亦为晴、无降水。数据来源：中国天气/华风爱科。
💨 空气优：08:00 中国 AQI 15，PM2.5 1、PM10 4，O3 45、NO2 8、SO2 2，未标注主要污染物，空气优良。未来几天仅有空气质量类别（无数值型 AQI/PM 分时预报）：周五、周六和 12/03 周四为「优」，周日、周二、周三为「良」，周一（11/30）为「轻度污染」。
🏃 训练：今日周五是早健身日，也是可选跑日。须点名提醒大风：08:20 已是西北风 33.8 km/h（风力 5 级），此后阵风进一步加大，10:00 约 48.2 km/h（阵风 6 级），11:00–12:00 可达 50.0 km/h（阵风 7 级），下午仍多在 6 级。蓝色预警覆盖至 20 时，山区局地阵风可达 9 级以上。气温 0~10°C，体感可到 -4.0°C，空气优、日预报无降水。早健身请防风保暖；户外跑不宜安排在今日。周一（11/30）早健身日阵风 31.5 km/h（阵风 5 级），空气为轻度污染，也需注意。周二（12/01）是冬季中午跑日，阵风约 16.7 km/h（阵风 3 级），空气良，降水概率 2%，相对更合适。
📅 未来7天：
• 周五 11/27：晴转多云，0~10°C，西北风，降水 0%，阵风 50.0 km/h（7 级，需提醒）；早健身注意防风，空气优；可选跑日但不宜户外跑
• 周六 11/28：多云转晴，-1~11°C，降水 0%，阵风 37.0 km/h（5 级），空气优
• 周日 11/29：晴，0~10°C，降水 1%，阵风 13.0 km/h（3 级），空气良
• 周一 11/30：多云，0~12°C，降水 0%，阵风 31.5 km/h（5 级），空气轻度污染；早健身日，注意防风与空气
• 周二 12/01：多云转晴，-1~12°C，降水 2%，阵风 16.7 km/h（3 级），空气良；冬季中午跑日
• 周三 12/02：晴转多云，-1~10°C，降水 2%，阵风 14.8 km/h（3 级），空气良
• 周四 12/03：多云转阴，-3~5°C，降水 14%，阵风 14.8 km/h（3 级），空气优；可选跑日，气温明显偏低，有一定降水概率
tip.en:
🏠 Beijing at 08:20 is sunny, 9.0°C (feels like 5.0°C), humidity 28%, northwesterly wind 33.8 km/h (force 5), gusts 33.8 km/h, UV very weak (index 2), visibility 30.0 km, no precipitation. The observatory issued a blue gale warning at 14:40 on Nov 26: from 02:00 to 20:00 on the 27th, most of the city will see force 3–4 northerly winds, with gusts around force 7, and locally force 9 or higher in the mountains. Today’s forecast is sunny by day and cloudy at night, 0–10°C (feels like about -4.0 to 7.3°C), daily precipitation probability 0%, 9.2 hours of sunshine; sunrise 07:12, sunset 16:51. Day-max gusts 50.0 km/h (gust force 7). In the hourly forecast, the 09:00 slot is labelled light rain with a 55% precipitation probability, but precipitation amount is 0.0 mm; from 10:00 onward it is cloudy or sunny with a 0% probability. The daily forecast is sunny with a 0% probability, and the 08:20 observation is also sunny with no rain. Source: China Weather / Huafeng Aike.
💨 Air quality is Good/优: 08:00 China AQI 15, PM2.5 1, PM10 4, O3 45, NO2 8, SO2 2, no primary pollutant listed. Later days only have an air-quality category (no numeric AQI/PM by time of day): Friday, Saturday and Thursday 12/03 are Good/优; Sunday, Tuesday and Wednesday are Moderate/良; Monday (Nov 30) is Lightly Polluted/轻度污染.
🏃 Training: Friday is a morning-gym day and also the optional run day. Wind must be flagged: at 08:20 the northwesterly is already 33.8 km/h (force 5), then gusts rise further — about 48.2 km/h (force 6) at 10:00 and 50.0 km/h (force 7) at 11:00–12:00, remaining around force 6 through the afternoon. The blue warning runs through 20:00, with mountain gusts up to force 9+. Temperatures are 0–10°C and can feel as low as -4.0°C; air is Good and the daily forecast has no rain. Tuesday (Dec 1) is the winter midday run day, with gusts of about 16.7 km/h (force 3), Moderate air and a 2% precipitation probability, which is more reasonable.
📅 Next 7 days:
• Fri 11-27: sunny then cloudy, 0–10°C, northwesterly, precip 0%, gusts 50.0 km/h (force 7, worth flagging); watch the wind for the morning gym; air Good; optional run day but not for an outdoor run
• Sat 11-28: cloudy then sunny, -1–11°C, precip 0%, gusts 37.0 km/h (force 5), air Good

• Tue 12-01: cloudy then sunny, -1–12°C, precip 2%, gusts 16.7 km/h (force 3), air Moderate; winter midday run day

zh.lead: 今天最值得看的，是 Karpathy 用 Claude Opus 5.5 做出的美国真实数据文明地图；产品上，OpenAI 纠正了 GPT-6.2 用量计费，并已发放一次 banked reset。

important.title: 重要消息
items: 11 月 26 日 10:31，Karpathy 用 Claude Opus 5.5 做出美国文明风格地图：约 7 小时、4.5 万行代码，汇入 31 个公开数据源，对齐到 25 公里六边形网格。演示在 karpathy.ai/usaciv/，使用 Claude Code 桌面端。
OpenAI 的 Tibo 称，GPT-6.2 上线时用量计费有误，Astra 与 Sol 被少计。现已修正，Astra 会快约 40% 触及上限，Sol 约 25%。既往差额不补收；Go、Plus、Pro、Business 获一次 banked reset，同日 15:26 确认生效。
OpenClaw 昨日 09:37 发布 Gateway-only 的 extended-stable（当前 LTS）版本 v2026.10.34，加入安全修复和 GPT-6.2 支持。发布时最新功能版仍是 v2026.11.10，无原生应用包。

sections.title: 实验室与工程
sections.body: 地图用「金币」表示 GDP，并按真实产业配置城市区块。Andrew Ng、Meta 和 Claude 官方近一日无新帖。

sections.title: 产品栏
sections.body: Hermes 稳定版仍为 v0.23.4。Harness 仍为 dsh-v0.2.3-alpha.2。codex 稳定版仍为 0.172.0，实验线到 0.174.0-alpha.8。Cursor changelog 自 11 月 6 日无新条目，Grok Bot 仍为 v1.3.0。CursorBench 4.1 较昨日无更新。

sections.title: 论文与演示
sections.body: alphaXiv 首页最前仍是《Recursive Collective Intelligence》，随后是一篇量子引力预印本和《Mixture-of-Loops Transformer》。更靠后的《Frontier-Eng》用 47 个工程任务评测自我演化智能体。

sections.title: 缺口
sections.body: AlphaGenome 2 博文标注发布于 11 月 11 日，不作为今日新发布。水木正文未打开。港股今早尚未开盘。

en.lead: The item most worth opening today is Karpathy’s Civilization-style US map, built with Claude Opus 5.5 from real public data. On the product side, OpenAI has corrected GPT-6.2 usage billing and issued a banked reset.

important.title: Highlights
items: At 10:31 on November 26, Karpathy used Claude Opus 5.5 to build a Civilization-style US map: about seven hours, 45,000 lines of code, 31 public sources on a 25 km hex grid. The demo is at karpathy.ai/usaciv/, made with the Claude Code desktop app.

Tibo said a billing mistake at the launch of GPT-6.2 undercounted Astra and Sol usage. It is now fixed: limits will be reached about 40% faster on Astra and about 25% on Sol. Past usage will not be back-charged, and one banked reset was added for Go, Plus, Pro, and Business; at 15:26 he confirmed it was online.

OpenClaw published a gateway-only extended-stable (current LTS) release, v2026.10.34, at 09:37 yesterday, with security fixes and GPT-6.2 support. The latest feature release at the time was still v2026.11.10, with no native-app package.

sections.title: Labs and engineering
sections.body: The map uses gold for GDP and assigns city districts from real industries. Andrew Ng, Meta, and the official Claude account had no new posts in the past day.

sections.title: Products
sections.body: Hermes remains at stable v0.23.4. Harness remains dsh-v0.2.3-alpha.2. Codex stable is still 0.172.0; the experimental line has reached 0.174.0-alpha.8. The Cursor changelog still has nothing newer than November 6, and Grok Bot remains v1.3.0. CursorBench 4.1 is unchanged versus yesterday.

sections.title: Papers and demos
sections.body: Still first on the alphaXiv homepage is Recursive Collective Intelligence, followed by a quantum-gravity preprint and Mixture-of-Loops Transformer. Further down, Frontier-Eng benchmarks self-evolving agents on 47 engineering tasks.

sections.title: Gaps
sections.body: The AlphaGenome 2 blog post is dated November 11, so it is not treated as a same-day launch. NewSMTH post bodies were not opened. The Hong Kong cash market had not yet opened this morning.

summary.zh: 展示用 Claude Opus 5.5 做成的美国真实数据文明风格地图：约 7 小时、4.5 万行代码，汇入 31 个公开数据源，对齐到 25 公里六边形网格，演示在 karpathy.ai/usaciv/。
summary.en: Shows a Civilization-style map of the US built with Claude Opus 5.5 from real public data: about seven hours and 45,000 lines of code, 31 sources on a 25 km hex grid, deployed at karpathy.ai/usaciv/.

caption.zh: Karpathy 演示预告片截帧（已镜像入仓）
caption.en: Frame from Karpathy’s demo trailer (mirrored into the repo)

summary.zh: 称 GPT-6.2 上线时用量计费有误，多数用户的 Astra 与 Sol 被少计；现已修正，Astra 会快约 40% 触及上限，Sol 约 25%。其他模型不受影响，既往差额不补收，并将向 Go、Plus、Pro 和 Business 发放一次 banked reset。
summary.en: Says a billing mistake at the launch of GPT-6.2 undercounted Astra and Sol usage for most users. It is now fixed, so limits will be reached about 40% faster on Astra and about 25% faster on Sol. Other models were unaffected, past usage will not be back-charged, and one banked reset will be added for Go, Plus, Pro, and Business.

summary.zh: 跟进上午的致歉说明，确认「Banked reset is online」，即向受影响套餐用户发放的一次 banked reset 已经生效。
summary.en: Follows the morning apology, confirming that “Banked reset is online,” meaning the promised one-off banked reset is now in effect.

title.zh: 递归的集体智能：同等预算梯子上的多智能体涌现
title.en: Recursive Collective Intelligence: Emergence on an Equal-Budget Ladder in Multi-Agent LLM Systems

summary.zh: alphaXiv 首页最前仍是这篇多智能体论文。首页列出的作者是 Lixuan He、Shengqu Cai 和李飞飞，标注约 1,000 次浏览。论文用「同等预算梯子」在对齐计算量的条件下，衡量群体互动是否强于单个智能体、多数投票和 pass@n，以及群体能否用自己已验证的工作改进下一代。摘要依据公开摘要与首页介绍撰写，未编造其他实验数字。
summary.en: Still first on the alphaXiv homepage. The homepage lists Lixuan He, Shengqu Cai, and Li Fei-Fei, with about 1,000 views. The paper uses an equal-budget ladder, with compute aligned, to test whether group interaction beats a single agent, majority vote, and pass@n, and whether a group can improve its next generation from its own verified work. This summary uses the public abstract and the homepage blurb; no other experimental figures are invented.

title.zh: 从零锥出发的引力代数量子化
title.en: An algebraic quantization of gravity from the null cone

summary.zh: Venkatesa Chandrasekaran 的预印本出现在今日首页第二位。首页介绍写到，一种零边界上的量子化使有限耦合下的引力跃迁幅有限，并能恢复黑洞熵和半经典爱因斯坦方程。这是一篇引力理论论文，不是智能体或语言模型工作。摘要只依据首页介绍撰写。
summary.en: Venkatesa Chandrasekaran’s preprint appears second on today’s homepage. The blurb says a null-boundary quantization makes gravitational transition amplitudes finite at finite coupling and recovers black-hole entropy and the semiclassical Einstein equations. This is a gravity-theory paper, not an agents or language-model result. The summary uses only the homepage blurb.

title.zh: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer
title.en: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer

summary.zh: Lianghui Zhu、Shijie Wang、Xinggang Wang 等来自华中科技大学、字节跳动 Seed 和多伦多大学。论文讨论循环语言模型如何在循环之间复用 KV 记忆，从而在单次遍历中解码每个生成 token，以接近标准 Transformer 的延迟。该文出现在今日首页靠前位置。摘要依据公开作者页与首页介绍撰写。
summary.en: Lianghui Zhu, Shijie Wang, Xinggang Wang, and colleagues at Huazhong University of Science and Technology, ByteDance Seed, and the University of Toronto discuss reusing KV memory across loops so a looped language model can decode each generated token in one traversal, approaching standard Transformer latency. The paper appears near the top of today’s homepage. This summary uses the public author page and the homepage blurb.

summary.zh: 稳定版较昨日无更新，仍为 11 月 24 日发布的 v0.23.4。最新 canary 仍是昨日已记录的 canary.20261125T064800Z-v0.23.4，未见更新的 canary 或稳定版。

summary.zh: 昨日 09:37（北京时间）发布 v2026.10.34，这是一条只覆盖 Gateway 的 extended-stable（当前相当于 LTS）线，从 v2026.10.33 打补丁，包含 10 月底代码加上安全、可靠性和性能修复，以及新模型支持。亮点包括在 OpenAI 与 ClawRouter 上选择 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 Sol 并缓存系统提示、群组私信的独立审批、更新恢复、子任务完成后及时交付，以及 Telegram/Discord 通道修复；新令牌改走通道密钥存储，不再明文写入配置。它更新核心 npm 包和 Gateway Docker 镜像，没有原生应用包。发布时最新功能版仍是 11 月 25 日的 v2026.11.10，该功能版较昨日无更新。
summary.en: v2026.10.34 was published at 09:37 Beijing time yesterday. It is a gateway-only extended-stable (the current LTS equivalent) patch on v2026.10.33: OpenClaw from the end of October plus security, reliability, and performance fixes, and new model support. Highlights include selecting GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol on OpenAI and ClawRouter with system-prompt caching, a separate approval policy for group DMs, update recovery, delivering finished child results without waiting for other helpers, and Telegram/Discord recovery fixes; new tokens are saved through the channel secret store rather than written to config as plaintext. It updates the core npm package and Gateway Docker images, with no native-app releases. The latest feature release at the time remained v2026.11.10 from November 25, which is unchanged versus yesterday.

By score divided by cost per task, Haiku 5.5 Low still leads on value (27.8% / $0.08, about 347.5 points/$), followed by Haiku 5.5 Medium (34.2% / $0.17) and Haiku 5.5 High (37.5% / $0.31). summary.en: Friday morning collection; the HK cash market has not yet opened, so there is no new print. The quote is Thursday’s close: HK$26.600, up 0.15% (+0.040), on about 127.0M shares and about HK$3.428 billion; the session ranged 26.58–27.72 after opening at 27.20. text.zh: 今日重心（周五去敏）：工作上继续拆解生产架构细节并推进上线规划，包括对 skill 实现方案的审阅和相关任务跟进；下午还要梳理主要功能迁移进展，并做一次内部同步。同时推进 2027 年服务端目标的对齐，知识库文档迁移仍在进行。流式语音识别接入仍是优先事项。学习上继续技术文章阅读和 pstack，通识课（万维钢思考工具）继续推进。今日是早健身日，也是可选跑日，但有大风蓝色预警，阵风可达 7 级，户外跑不宜安排。
text.en: Friday focus (sanitized): on the work side, keep breaking down production-architecture details and the launch plan, including a review of the skill-implementation design and related follow-ups; in the afternoon, also go through the status of major feature migrations and do an internal sync. Aligning 2027 server-side goals continues, as does knowledge-base document migration. Streaming speech-recognition integration remains a priority. On the learning side, continue the technical-article reading and pstack, and keep going on the general-education course (Wan Weigang’s thinking tools). Today is a morning-gym day and also the optional run day, but a blue gale warning is in effect with gusts up to force 7, so an outdoor run is not advisable.
